title: Hiring: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Hiring: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Long-Term Project)



We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build a custom management system from scratch for our online education business.



Our students normally subscribe through our main website using credit/debit cards. However, many students in countries like Kenya, Somalia, and Ethiopia pay manually using mobile money or other local payment methods. We need a separate internal system to manage these customers.



Core Features



Student Registration & Manual Payments



* Register students who pay manually.

* Track payment method, amount, date, and reference.

* Verify manual payments before activating the subscription.

* Activate memberships (monthly, quarterly, yearly).

* Automatically show Active, Expiring, and Expired accounts.

* Send automatic
 reminders before subscriptions expire.



Customer Service Dashboard



* Daily phone calls made.

* Calls answered.

* Interested leads.

* New paid members.

* Conversion rate.

* Commission tracking.

* Daily reports.



Operations Manager Dashboard



* Track customer complaints.

* Record negative feedback.

* Assign and monitor customer service tasks.

* View team performance and reports.



CEO Dashboard



* Complete business overview.

* Membership statistics.

* Revenue and payment reports.

* Customer service performance.

* Complaints and resolutions.

* Key business metrics in one place.



Requirements



* Strong experience with full-stack web development.

* Experience building custom CRM/admin systems.

* Clean, scalable architecture built from scratch.

* Ability to add new features as the business grows.

* Excellent communication in English.

* Available for regular Zoo
etings.

* Able to start immediately.



Engagement



We are open to:



* Full-time hourly

* Fixed-price project

* Long-term partnership



Please include:



* Examples of similar systems you have built.

* Your preferred tech stack.

* Your availability.

* Your hourly rate or project estimate.



This is not a simple website. We are looking for someone who can become our long-term development partner and help us continuously improve and expand the platform.

title: Scaffold Designers / Draughtspeople
description:
Work on Global Construction Projects



Join a growing consultancy team delivering scaffold and temporary works designs for international construction projects across Australia, the UK, the Middle East, and Asia.

This is not just a drafting job.



You will work on real scaffold and access solutions for live construction projects - helping solve technical challenges and contributing to how projects are delivered in the real world.



If you enjoy problem-solving, thinking technically, and working on meaningful projects with international teams, this could be a strong long-term career opportunity.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Producing scaffold and temporary works drawings for live construction projects 

• Assisting with scaffold and access design solutions 

• Working alongside international teams and clients 

• Supporting project delivery from concept through to final design 

• Developing buildable, practical solutions - not just drawings 

• Contributing ideas and technical input to improve project outcomes 



What We Offer

• Real Project Work

o Work on live scaffold and access designs for a variety of international projects.

• International Exposure

o Collaborate with teams and clients across Australia, the UK, the Middle East, and Asia.

• Structured Development

o Ongoing support, mentoring, and technical development to help you grow.

• Career Progression

o Clear progression opportunities into Senior Designer and Lead Designer roles.



Career Path

• Designer - Approx. 6 Months 

• Senior Designer - 12–24 Months 

• Lead Designer - 24–36 Months 

• International Opportunities 



This Role Is for you If:

• You enjoy solving technical problems 

• You think about how things are built 

• You want to work on real construction projects 

• You take your career seriously 

• You are eager to learn and develop technical skills 

• You want long-term career growth 



This Role Is NOT for you If:

• You only want easy, repetitive work 

• You avoid problem-solving 

• You are not interested in learning 

• You are only looking for a short-term job 



Skills & Experience

Experience in any of the following:

• AutoCAD 

• SketchUp 

• Construction drawings 

• Scaffolding or temporary works knowledge 

• Structural or civil drafting 

• Engineering or construction background 



Candidates with strong technical thinking and the right attitude will also be considered, even if they come from a non-traditional background.



Why This Opportunity Is Different

Most drafting roles involve repetitive production work.

This opportunity is focused on developing high-level technical designers who understand real-world construction, build-ability, and problem-solving.

You will be encouraged to think, contribute ideas, and grow into a valuable technical member of the team.



How to Apply

Apply here: 
 

Use Referral Code: JOSP260401

Please also share this opportunity with anyone who may be suitable.

description:
Traidie is recruiting an experienced Tekla Draftsperson to join a growing consultancy team delivering scaffold and temporary works designs for international construction projects.

Essential requirement

You must have:

• At least three years of professional experience using Tekla Structures

• Examples of your own Tekla models and drawing output that you can confidently present and discuss



Please do not apply if you cannot demonstrate both of these requirements.



Previous scaffolding experience is not essential. However, you must already be a confident and experienced Tekla user. Training will be provided in scaffold design, ScaffPlan and the company’s internal standards, but not in the fundamentals of Tekla Structures.



What you’ll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

• Creating accurate 3D scaffold models using Tekla Structures and ScaffPlan

• Converting 3D models into clear and accurate 2D construction drawings

• Producing layouts, plans, sections, elevations, details and 3D views

• Coordinating IFC, DWG, DXF, PDF and point-cloud information where required

• Identifying clashes, missing information and potential constructability issues

• Producing material and equipment lists from completed models

• Revising models and drawings following internal reviews and engineering feedback

• Completing your own quality checks before submitting work for review

• Working with Australian designers, engineers and project managers

• Managing assigned work to meet agreed deadlines



What we’re looking for

To be considered, you must have:

• A minimum of three years’ professional Tekla Structures experience

• Strong 3D modelling and construction-documentation skills

• Proven experience converting 3D models into accurate 2D drawings

• Experience producing plans, sections, elevations and construction details

• A good understanding of construction drawings, dimensions, levels and structural geometry

• Strong spatial awareness and attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• The ability to understand written instructions, drawing mark-ups and verbal project briefings

• Good time-management and organisational skills

• Availability during agreed Australian business hours

• A reliable and accountable approach to your work



Highly regarded experience

The following would be an advantage but is not essential:

• Scaffold drafting or scaffold design

• ScaffPlan

• Temporary works or construction access systems

• Point clouds or laser-scanning data

• Australian construction or engineering projects

• IFC and CAD-reference coordination

• A qualification in drafting, BIM, engineering technology, construction or a related field



What you’ll receive

• Structured onboarding and technical guidance

• Training in ScaffPlan and scaffold-design workflows

• Exposure to varied international construction projects

• The opportunity to develop specialist scaffold and temporary-works knowledge

• Long-term professional development and increased project responsibility



How to apply

Apply at: 

Use referral code: JOSP260717

• Your current CV

• Examples of your own Tekla work, including both 3D models and completed 2D drawings

Applications without evidence of at least three years’ professional Tekla Structures experience will not progress.

title: Operations  Quality Manager — Digital Management Agency (Remote)
description:
We are a fast-growing digital management agency scaling rapidly in both revenue and roster size. The single biggest lever on our revenue is operational consistency — making sure every creator on our platform is supported by workflows, quality standards, and systems that perform reliably every single week, regardless of who is working. This role owns that standard.



WHAT WE OFFER

— $1,000 to $1,300 per month base, depending on experience

 — 2 direct reports at hire, with scope to build and lead a growing quality function as the roster scales

 — A systems-ownership role with real operational impact at scale

 — Target start date: August 2026



THE ROLE

* This role does not sell, and it does not reinvent the playbook. It makes sure the playbook is executed consistently, reviewed rigorously, and improved continuously.

* As Operations Quality Manager you will own the operational quality of our creator portfolio. You will make sure every workflow behind the Chat team is followed correctly, every output meets a defined standard, and quality never drifts as the operation scales. You will manage a Content VA and Audience Engagement VA at hire, with responsibility to build and lead the quality function as the department grows.

* Success here is defined by how consistently the operation performs — not by how much work you personally do.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

* Operational quality end to end — own QA across core workflows covering content planning, PPV and customs preparation, welcome bundles, profile optimisation, audience engagement, and cross-team issue resolution, with a quality check built into every handoff before it reaches the Chat team

* The weekly quality cadence — lead a data-driven weekly review of every creator's core quality and compliance metrics, translate gaps into specific corrective actions, and hold the team accountable against a visible quality scorecard

* Quality governance and standards enforcement — QA every workflow output against a defined quality and brand standard before it reaches the Chat team, with a strong audience-experience lens so content is packaged to convert — nothing ships below bar

SOP adoption and documentation — keep every process documented, adopted, and current, using AI tooling to build, audit, and refresh workflows so adherence stays high as the operation evolves

* Team coaching and cross-functional coordination — coach and develop the operations team toward consistent execution standards, partner with Chat and Client Success to resolve creator concerns within SLA, protecting retention and reducing churn

* Prioritisation and corrective action — review account performance weekly, identify recurring issues and lagging accounts, prioritise QA resources based on revenue opportunity and quality risk, and track improvement plans through completion



NON-NEGOTIABLES

— Adherence discipline: the SOP is the standard — no undocumented workarounds and no skipped quality checks under pressure

 — Data over opinion: every judgment on quality, content, and priorities is anchored to performance data, reviewed weekly

 — Standards leadership: holds the line on quality and process even under pressure to cut corners for short-term output



WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON

— Weekly deliverables consistently shipped on time and meeting defined QA standards

 — Operational concerns resolved within agreed SLAs, each with a durable fix logged

 — Quality trends improving consistently across the portfolio, with recurring issues traced to root cause and lagging accounts closed rather than ignored

 — Chat team consistently receiving complete, production-ready content and assets

 — SOP adherence staying high, enabling rapid onboarding and reducing dependence on any single individual

 — Rework and recurring errors declining quarter over quarter

 — Tea
mbers coached to consistent, independent, on-standard execution

Targets and weightings set quarterly with the Chief Revenue Officer.



WHAT YOU BRING

Experience (non-negotiable)

 — 3+ years in operations, quality assurance, or operations leadership within a remote, fast-paced business — agency, SaaS, startup, eCommerce, BPO, customer operations, or creator business

 — Demonstrated ownership of documented workflows, SOPs, quality standards, and measurable process improvement

 — Experience managing a remote team or direct reports

 — Creator economy or subscription platform experience preferred but not required

Skills (must-have)

 — Workflow platforms — Process Street, ClickUp, Asana, or similar

 — AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — used to build and maintain processes

 — Strong spreadsheet and data literacy, comfortable turning numbers into action

 — Comfortable analysing operational dashboards, identifying recurring quality issues, and translating data into clear corrective actions

 — SOP writing, quality documentation, and project management

 — Sound diagnostic judgment — able to distinguish a process failure from a people-performance issue, and a coaching opportunity from a systemic problem, and respond proportionally

Who you are (non-negotiable)

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Peakfinity Labs



**Employment Type:** [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]

**Department:** Marketing & Content



## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



   *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

   - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

   - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

   - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

   - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

---



Peakfinity Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Support & Sales Specialist | Full-Time | $800-$1,000+
description:
Are you ambitious, dependable and looking for a long-term remote career where you can genuinely develop your skills?



Today2Repair is looking for someone who wants to become excellent at customer communication and sales, not simply clear an inbox as quickly as possible.



Quick Overview



- Position: Customer Support & Sales Specialist

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Schedule: Monday through Saturday

- Working hours: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time

- Break: One hour per working day

- Salary: $800 to $1,000+ USD per month

- Employment: Full-time and long-term

- Experience: Helpful, but not required

- Dutch language skills: Not required



About Today2Repair



Today2Repair is a fast-growing Dutch tech repair brand specializing in phones, tablets, laptops, gaming consoles and smartwatches.



Through our social media content, customers from across the Netherlands and Belgium contact us for advice and repairs. You can find us on Instagram and TikTok 
 are a small, ambitious team with high standards. We communicate openly, give direct feedback and constantly look for ways to improve.



The Role



You will manage conversations with potential and existing customers through WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels inside GoHighLevel.



Your goal is to understand what customers need, give them a professional experience and help qualified leads move toward booking a repair.



Our customers communicate in Dutch. You do not need to speak Dutch. You will use DeepL and AI tools to help translate messages, but you must carefully check the context, tone and final result before sending anything.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position with many unrelated tasks. Customer support, follow-up and sales will be your main responsibilities.



What You Will Do



- Respond to customer inquiries through GoHighLevel

- Understand the customer’s situation before recommending a next step

- Recognize strong purchasing intent and follow up quickly

- Guide qualified customers toward booking a repair

- Keep active conversations moving

- Follow up with leads who have not yet booked

- Use DeepL and AI responsibly when communicating in Dutch

- Proofread every translated message before sending it

- Keep contacts, opportunities and appointments accurate in GoHighLevel

- Escalate technical questions when input from a technician is needed

- Work toward targets for response time, message quality, follow-up and conversion

- Learn from feedback and contribute ideas for improving our processes



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if:



- You communicate professionally and naturally in English

- You are warm and helpful, while still being commercially aware

- You take pride in doing small things properly

- You notice details that other people miss

- You take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded

- You remain reliable when work becomes busy or repetitive

- You are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- You genuinely want to learn and improve

- You have a quiet, professional workspace

- You have reliable internet and a backup solution

- You are looking for a stable, long-term position with one company



Previous experience in customer support, sales, GoHighLevel or another CRM is helpful, but it is not required. Strong potential, preparation, judgment and grit matter more to us than having the longest resume.



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If



- You want to combine this position with another full-time job

- You prefer rushing through messages instead of understanding customers

- You rely on AI without checking its work

- You dislike feedback, targets or performance reviews

- You cannot consistently work the required schedule

- You are mainly looking for a temporary position



Compensation and Development



- Starting salary of $800 to $1,000+ USD per month

- The exact offer depends on your application, communication and performance during the paid trial

- Paid training

- Performance and salary review after the first 90 days

- Opportunity to grow in responsibility and compensation based on performance



What Success Looks Like



- Customers receive timely and thoughtful responses

- High-intent leads receive fast follow-up

- Conversations move toward a clear next step

- Customer information in GoHighLevel remains accurate

- Messages are clear, professional and free from avoidable mistakes

- Feedback results in visible improvement

- Customers feel that someone genuinely understands and wants to help them



How to Apply



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.



Please use exactly 8 Apply Points. There is no advantage to using more than 8. We evaluate the quality of your application and video, not how many additional points you spend.



Use this subject line:



T2R Customer Support - [Your First Name]



Your application must include:



1. A Personal Video



Send a video recorded specifically for Today2Repair.



A video of approximately 3 to 6 minutes will usually be enough, but we care more about the quality of your answers than the exact length.



Record the video from the workspace you would actually use for this job. Professional editing is not required. Clear audio, good lighting, preparation and a quiet environment are important.



Notes are fine, but please speak naturally instead of reading a fully generated script.



Answer these questions:



- Who are you, and what are you currently doing?

- Why are you interested in this specific position at Today2Repair?

- Tell us about a situation where you continued working toward something even when it became difficult, uncomfortable or repetitive.

- What is one specific thing you noticed after looking 

- Tell us about a time someone trusted you with an important responsibility. What did you do to earn and maintain that trust?



Upload your video to Loom, Google Drive, YouTube or a similar platform.



Before applying, make sure we can open the link without requesting access. Please do not submit an old or generic introduction video.



2. Practical Information



Confirm in writing:



- That you can work Monday through Saturday from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time

- Whether you currently have another job or client

- Your internet speed and backup internet solution

- When you would be available to start



Important



We use AI in our work, but we want to understand your own personality, communication and judgment.



You may use tools to check your application, but generic or completely AI-generated applications will not move forward.



Applications without the requested video or practical information will not be considered.



Selection Process



- OnlineJobs application and personal video

- Shortlist questionnaire with customer scenarios

- Live interview and customer roleplay

- Paid practical trial

- Final decision



We are not looking for the person with the longest resume.



We are looking for someone with high standards, strong potential and the determination to become excellent at this role.

title: Client Response and Outreach Coordinator - Australian Day Shift, 7:00am to 10:00am Manila, Monday to Friday
description:
$8.75 USD per hour. 15 hours per week guaranteed, up to 20 as required.



About us



Ready2Exit is Australia's leading SMB M&A advisory firm. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's largest business marketplace with over 180,000 members. 



We are a lean team which means this role carries more weight than the same title would carry somewhere larger. You will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about

Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that 
nt whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.

The second is precision. Details are not administration in this business. A wrong figure in a follow up
 can cost us a mandate that took months to win.

The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role

You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. That outbound work is yours as well. It is not cold selling. It is ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a conversation.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. That is not an administrative job, and I do not intend to treat it as one.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and
, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by
 and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding
s and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.

Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We do not pretend to be larger than we are.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



Your English needs to be strong in both directions. You will be speaking with Australian owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and they will hang up if following you takes effort. You will also be writing
s that go out under my name into live deals, so your written English needs to be good enough that I can send it as it is.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are the ones who are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who is genuinely detail obsessed, to the point of finding the error nobody told you was there. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work out the rest without needing to be walked through it. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.

What you get



The rate is $8.75 USD per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate. You are also paid 13th month.



On growth, I will be straight with you rather than make a promise I cannot stand behind. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That will happen when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard, not on a fixed date I invent now to make this advertisement more attractive. If both of those things are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because there is no version of this job where you are kept at arm's length from the real work.



Nice to have, though not required

Experience with GoHighLevel, SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply

Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.

1. Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

2. Then answer these three questions, briefly:



- What was your response time target in your last role, and what happened when you missed it?

- Tell me about the last time something urgent interrupted you mid task. What happened to the work you were in the middle of?

- What is your internet speed, and what do you do when it drops out?



3. Record a video of one to two minutes and include the link. An unlisted YouTube video, a Loom or a Google Drive link are all fine. Speak to camera and tell me why this role interests you, why you are the right fit for it, and what makes you the standout candidate.



Please do not script it. I want to hear you think. A polished read tells me nothing about how you will sound on a live call with an Australian business owner, and that is the part of the job I actually need to assess.



Attach your CV.



Stuart Earl

M&A Advisor | Founder, Ready2Exit

Australia's leading SMB M&A Advisory Firm

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Scope of Work

We are a U.S. Healthcare-based company seeking an expert in Philippine labour law and human resources to produce a comprehensive guide/checklist covering the following:

-How to determine whether a worker in the Philippines should be engaged as a contractor (independent contractor) vs. an employee, under Philippine law.

-A checklist for engaging someone in the Philippines as a contractor: what must be done to comply (from U.S. company perspective + Philippine perspective).

-What documents need to be collected and retained for on?boarding a contractor in the Philippines (e.g., ID, passport, tax registration, local business registration if applicable, contract for services, etc.).

-How to establish a Philippine entity (or outsource structure) so our U.S. company can hire or engage Philippines?based contractor(s) legally, including the steps, registration requirements, fees, entity types (branch vs subsidiary vs local contractor), and compliance obligations (tax/social security/benefits).

-Useful practical matters: hours/day, hours/week, benefits (what one must provide or not provide if truly a contractor), pay schedule (suggested best practice), and risk mitigation (what to avoid to prevent mis?classification and employer liability).

-Written guide in checklist/table format, with explanatory text, and with all major legal references (Philippine statutes/regulations/DOLE pronouncements) cited in footnotes or end?notes.

-Maintaining HIPAA compliance

BOTTOM LINE: How to on-board a contractor while maintaining compliance under Philippine law and HIPAA compliance



Deliverables

A Word or PDF document with:

Section A: Contractor vs Employee – classification overview, key criteria, legal references.

Section B: Checklist for engaging a contractor in the Philippines (step?by?step).

Section C: Documents on?boarding checklist (for contractor individual and for your U.S. company).

Section D: How to form a Philippine entity / legal vehicle, steps, entity types, compliance obligations.

Section E: Practical terms: hours/day, hours/week, pay schedule, benefits (what to provide vs what to avoid for independent contractor), POA/contract drafting tips, monitoring/control risks.

Section F: Reference appendix – list of laws/regulations with citations (government site links where available).



Budget & Timeline

Pay: USD$7 per hour, up to maximum 10 hours total (i.e., USD$70 maximum).

Timeline: Complete draft within 2 business days after contract.

Payment terms: Upon delivery of final document and acceptance.



Required Expertise

-Proven experience in Philippine labour law (especially classification of contractors vs employees) and HR compliance.

-Ability to reference Philippine laws/regulations (e.g., Labour Code, DOLE Department Orders, relevant jurisprudence).

-Experience advising foreign (U.S.) companies hiring in the Philippines is a plus.

-Good English and ability to provide a clear, structured checklist format.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
You'll be executing a focused 60-day SEO engagement for a U.S.-based B2B biotech client in the bioavailability and ingredient science space. The goal is measurable ranking improvement -- real movement on real keywords.



This role is managed through DeltaVise, a U.S. IT and digital services firm. You'll report directly to the account manager weekly with platform-verified activity logs.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



- Run a fresh SEMrush site audit and confirm keyword targets

- Conduct competitor keyword analysis to identify ranking gaps

- Optimize existing website pages around confirmed target keywords — meta titles, descriptions, H1/H2 structure, body copy, and internal linking

- Rewrite and refine existing page content to naturally incorporate target keywords without sacrificing readability

- Build strategic internal linking — correct anchor text, link equity distribution, crawl depth improvement

- Implement all on-page changes directly inside WordPress using Yoast SEO

- Submit URLs for indexing via Google Search Console as optimized pages go live

- Monitor GSC for indexing status, impressions, clicks, and ranking signals weekly

- Submit a weekly activity log (date, task, time spent, platform used) every Friday



WHAT WE'RE TRACKING AT DAY 60:



Keywords in Top 20 / Top 10

Keywords ranking total (target: 40+)

Pages with organic presence (target: 10+)

Non-branded impressions/mo (target: 200+)

Site Health Score (target: 95%+)



REQUIREMENTS:



2+ years of hands-on SEO execution — actual on-page work, not agency reporting

SEMrush — site audit, position tracking, keyword research, competitor gap analysis

Google Search Console — ranking data, indexing issues, URL submission

WordPress — confident editing pages and content without breaking things

Yoast SEO — meta titles, descriptions, content scoring

Internal linking strategy — anchor text, link equity, crawl depth

Content writing/editing — ability to rewrite copy for a B2B science audience

Strong written English for weekly client-facing reports



HOW WE VERIFY WORK

Weekly time logs are required for payment release. If you're not comfortable with that level of accountability, this isn't the right fit.



HOW TO APPLY

Send all four of the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:



1. A past SEO engagement summary: what the site was, what you did, and what moved — specific numbers only

2. Screenshot or export of a SEMrush audit or position tracking report you personally produced

3. Your available hours per week and timezone

4. In 2-3 sentences: what does bioavailability mean and why does it matter to a B2B ingredient supplier?

title: Advanced Video Editor & Content Strategist for Concrete Construction Brand
description:
Greater Valley Concrete is hiring an advanced video editor and content strategist who can turn raw construction footage into high-quality, engaging content for:



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos



This is not a basic video-editing position.



We are not looking for someone who only adds captions, transitions, and trending music. We need someone who understands advanced editing, content strategy, storytelling, hooks, audience retention, video quality, exporting, thumbnails, voiceover scripting, analytics, and lead generation.



You must be available to start immediately.



This position will begin with a paid trial period. If you prove that you are skilled, reliable, organized, and capable of working independently, this can become a consistent long-term position.



## About Greater Valley Concrete



Greater Valley Concrete is a licensed concrete and landscaping company based in California.



Our services include:



* Concrete driveways

* Patios and walkways

* Stamped concrete

* Concrete slabs

* Artificial turf

* Retaining walls

* Drainage systems

* Pavers

* Landscaping

* Outdoor-living transformations



We have a growing library of footage recorded using:



* Two GoPro cameras

* Worker point-of-view footage

* Wide-angle jobsite footage

* DJI camera footage

* Cellphone videos

* Before-and-after footage

* Owner voiceovers

* Customer testimonials



One GoPro is often worn by the worker completing the main forming, preparation, reinforcement, and concrete work. The second camera captures wide shots of the crew, jobsite, and overall construction process.



We need someone who can turn this footage into a complete content system.



## What You Will Be Responsible For



You will be expected to:



* Review and organize raw GoPro, DJI, and cellphone footage

* Identify the strongest 
nts from each project

* Turn one project into multiple pieces of content

* Edit polished short-form vertical videos

* Edit longer YouTube project videos

* Create strong hooks within the first one to two seconds

* Write voiceover scripts for the owner

* Create professional YouTube thumbnails

* Add captions, text overlays, sound effects, music, and transitions

* Correct color, exposure, white balance, and audio

* Stabilize footage when necessary

* Maintain excellent video quality and clarity

* Export videos using the correct settings for each platform

* Write titles, captions, descriptions, and calls to action

* Track performance and recommend what should be tested next

* Tell us what additional footage we should capture



You must be proactive.



We do not want to explain every cut, hook, title, thumbnail, or content idea. You should be able to review the footage, understand what is happening, and recommend the strongest content angles.



## Content Strategy Is Required



We are not hiring someone only to make videos look good.



Our content should:



* Capture attention

* Maintain viewer retention

* Educate homeowners

* Demonstrate our workmanship

* Build trust

* Show proper construction methods

* Answer customer objections

* Help qualify potential customers

* Generate estimate requests

* Build Greater Valley Concrete into a recognizable local brand



You must understand:



* Strong hooks

* Watch time

* Audience retention

* Rewatches

* Pacing

* Curiosity

* Open loops

* Pattern interruptions

* Storytelling

* Educational content

* Authority-building content

* Before-and-after transformations

* Calls to action

* Local-service marketing

* Lead qualification through content



You should understand that different videos have different goals.



Some videos may be designed to attract views. Others may educate homeowners, answer objections, demonstrate proper preparation, showcase craftsmanship, build authority, or generate qualified leads.



## Voiceover Scriptwriting



The owner will record voiceovers for selected videos.



You must be able to review the footage and write strong, natural scripts based on what is actually happening in the project.



You may need to create:



* 15-second scripts

* 30-second scripts

* 45-second scripts

* 60-second scripts

* Long-form YouTube narration

* Multiple hook options

* Educational scripts

* Project-transformation scripts

* Problem-and-solution scripts

* Myth-busting scripts

* Customer-qualification scripts

* Calls to action



The scripts must sound natural, confident, educational, and conversational.



They should not sound robotic, overly formal, generic, or obviously written by artificial intelligence.



You should also be able to tell the owner:



* What the video should focus on

* What opening line to use

* What should be explained

* Which clips should match each sentence

* What tone should be used

* Where to pause

* What call to action should be included

* Whether additional footage is needed



Example hooks include:



* “This is the part of a concrete project most homeowners never see.”

* “The finished concrete looks good, but the most important work is underneath it.”

* “Here is why this driveway started cracking.”

* “Never let a contractor pour concrete directly over loose soil.”

* “This homeowner wanted to completely transform an unusable backyard.”

* “Here is what proper concrete preparation actually looks like.”

* “The cheapest concrete estimate can sometimes become the most expensive decision.”



These are examples only. You must be able to create original hooks and scripts based on our footage.



## Advanced Editing and Video-Quality Requirements



Maintaining professional video quality is one of the most important parts of this position.



You must understand how to edit, export, and compress high-resolution footage correctly without causing the final video to look blurry, pixelated, washed out, overly sharpened, dark, or low quality after uploading.



You should understand:



* 1080p and 4K workflows

* Source resolution

* Timeline resolution

* Frame rates

* Variable and constant frame rates

* Bitrate and bitrate ranges

* H.264 and H.265 codecs

* Platform compression

* Vertical and horizontal aspect ratios

* Export formats

* Color-space settings

* Audio export settings

* Proxy workflows

* Stabilization

* Color correction

* Color grading

* Exposure

* White balance

* Sharpness

* Noise reduction

* Audio cleanup

* Slow motion

* Speed ramping

* Reframing 4K footage into vertical content

* Exporting master files and platform-ready versions



You must know how to prepare content for:



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos



You should be able to explain:



* Which resolution you selected

* Which frame rate you selected

* Which codec you used

* Which bitrate you used

* Why you selected those settings

* How you prevented unnecessary compression

* How you maintained the quality of the original footage



Do not apply if you rely only on automatic export presets and cannot explain your settings.



## Thumbnail Requirements



You must know how to create professional and clickable YouTube thumbnails.



Thumbnails should:



* Be easy to understand immediately

* Have a clear visual focus

* Show a problem, transformation, or strong result

* Use limited but powerful text

* Be readable on mobile devices

* Create curiosity without being misleading

* Match the actual video

* Look professional



You should understand how thumbnails affect click-through rate and how to test different concepts.



Please include examples of thumbnails you personally created.



## Types of Content You Will Create



### Construction Process Content



* Demolition

* Excavation

* Base preparation

* Compaction

* Setting forms

* Installing rebar

* Installing drainage

* Concrete placement

* Screeding

* Bull floating

* Finishing

* Stamping

* Control joints

* Sealing

* Artificial-turf installation

* Retaining-wall construction

* Paver installation



### Educational Content



* Why base preparation matters

* Why concrete cracks

* Why reinforcement matters

* Proper concrete thickness

* Drainage mistakes

* Licensed versus unlicensed contractors

* How to compare estimates

* Questions homeowners should ask contractors

* Common construction shortcuts

* Stamped-concrete maintenance



### Transformation and Storytelling Content



* Before-and-after videos

* Complete project timelines

* Problem-and-solution videos

* Backyard transformations

* Driveway replacements

* Homeowner project stories

* Challenges encountered during a job

* How our crew solved problems



### Personality and Crew Content



* Worker point-of-view videos

* Day-in-the-life content

* Behind-the-scenes footage

* Jobsite challenges

* Crew conversations

* Satisfying construction 
nts

* Funny but professional jobsite 
nts



## Expected Weekly Output



This position will begin at approximately:



**25 hours per week**



Our starting production goal is approximately:



* 10 to 14 polished short-form videos per week

* Multiple hook variations for selected videos

* Voiceover scripts for selected videos

* YouTube thumbnails when needed

* One longer YouTube video when enough footage is available

* Organized footage and completed project folders

* A weekly performance and testing report



Quality, consistency, communication, and organization are extremely important.



## Turnaround-Time Expectations



You must work efficiently without sacrificing quality.



Expected turnaround times will generally be:



* First edited short-form video from a new project: within 24 to 48 hours after receiving organized footage and instructions

* Standard short-form revisions: within 24 hours

* Additional short-form videos from the same project: approximately one to two completed videos per working day

* Voiceover scripts: within 24 hours

* Thumbnail concepts: within 24 to 48 hours

* Long-form YouTube videos: approximately three to five working days, depending on footage length and complexity

* Urgent content requests: same day when agreed upon in advance



These deadlines begin after you receive the required footage, project information, and voiceover recordings.



You must communicate immediately if footage is missing, corrupted, unclear, or insufficient. Do not wait until the deadline to report a problem.



We value quality, but we also need dependable turnaround times and a repeatable system.



## One Project Should Produce Multiple Videos



We need someone who knows how to maximize footage.



One concrete project may produce:



* A before-and-after video

* A worker point-of-view video

* A demolition video

* A base-preparation video

* A rebar education video

* A concrete-pour video

* A satisfying finishing video

* A mistake-to-avoid video

* A homeowner-education video

* A complete transformation video

* A pricing-education video

* A long-form YouTube video

* Several shorter clips from the long-form video



We do not want several hours of footage turned into only one video.



## Performance Tracking



Every week, you should be able to report:



* Videos completed

* Videos published

* Views

* Average watch time

* Average percentage viewed

* Audience retention

* Rewatches

* Shares

* Saves

* Comments

* Profile visits

* Website clicks

* Leads generated

* Best-performing hooks

* Best-performing topics

* Best-performing video lengths

* What did not perform well

* What should be tested next



You should be able to explain why certain content performed better and how those lessons should affect future videos.



## Required Skills



You must have advanced experience with at least one of the following:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut Desktop



Experience with Adobe After Effects is a major advantage.



You should also have experience with:



* Canva or Adobe Photoshop

* YouTube thumbnails

* Short-form storytelling

* Voiceover scripting

* Content strategy

* Color correction

* Audio cleanup

* GoPro footage

* DJI footage

* 4K video editing

* Vertical-video editing

* YouTube content

* Social-media analytics

* Google Drive

* File organization



Experience editing construction, landscaping, home improvement, roofing, automotive, real estate, or another local-service business is strongly preferred.



## Computer and Internet Requirements



You must have:



* A computer capable of smoothly editing 4K footage

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Enough storage for large video files

* Professional editing software

* A reliable backup system

* Reliable communication



Do not apply if your computer cannot handle large GoPro and DJI files.



## Communication and Availability



You must communicate clearly and provide updates without needing to be chased.



You must be available for several overlapping hours during California business hours.



Preferred overlap:



**10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time**



You do not need to work this entire schedule, but you must have agreed hours available for feedback, approvals, meetings, and questions.



## Compensation



Compensation:



**$8 to $12 USD per hour, depending on experience, portfolio quality, technical knowledge, communication, and paid-test performance.**



This position will begin at approximately 25 hours per week.



The schedule may increase as our content system grows and the right person proves their ability to consistently produce high-quality work.



Applicants must clearly state their requested hourly rate.



## Immediate Start and Paid Trial Period



We are looking to hire immediately.



The position will begin with a paid trial period of approximately one to two weeks.



The initial trial may include up to 25 paid hours per week.



The trial will evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Video clarity

* Export knowledge

* Hook development

* Storytelling

* Content strategy

* Scriptwriting

* Thumbnail design

* Communication

Being selected for the trial does not guarantee a permanent position.



The person who performs best may receive consistent part-time work with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.



## Paid Test Assignment



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid test using our actual footage.



The test may require you to:



* Review raw GoPro and wide-angle footage

* Select the strongest clips

* Edit one 30-to-45-second vertical video

* Recommend additional content ideas from the footage



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the exact words:



**I BUILD CONTENT MACHINES**



Applications that do not begin with these words may be rejected.



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your years of professional editing experience.

3. The editing software you use.

4. Your computer specifications.

5. Your internet speed.

6. Your current availability.

7. The earliest date you can start.

10. Links to at least two long-form videos you edited.

11. Examples of thumbnails you personally created.

12. Examples of construction, landscaping, home-improvement, real-estate, or local-business content.

13. An explanation of how you would turn one concrete project into at least 10 different videos.

14. The export settings you would use for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

15. An explanation of how you prevent videos from becoming blurry.

16. An explanation of how you choose a hook.

17. An explanation of how you would help the owner record voiceovers.

18. Two professional references from current or recent clients.

19. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid test.

20. Confirmation that you can start immediately.



You must also submit a two-to-three-minute Loom video.



In the Loom video:



* Introduce yourself

* Show one video you personally edited

* Explain the hook

* Explain the pacing

* Explain the export settings

* Explain why you made your editing decisions



Also answer this question:



**After reviewing several hours of GoPro footage, what is your exact process for d
 which clips should become content?**



Generic answers will not be enough. Be specific and use examples from your actual experience.



## Do Not Apply If



* You are a beginner

* You only know basic editing

* You cannot edit 4K footage

* You do not understand export settings

* You cannot maintain video quality

About

At

We are a newly launched startup, and we are looking for a heavy-hitting B2B Closer to join us as our first Sales & Marketing Specialist. You won't just be booking appointments; you will be managing the pipeline from cold outreach to signed contract.

Own the Entire Sales Cycle: You will prospect, initiate contact, pitch, and close the deal. You are the primary closer. Our Founder and our Lead VA will be on the calls to support you with operational details and social proof, but you lead the dance and ask for the sale.

title: Creator Research and Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Voyage is a growth agency that builds digital products for creators. We partner with creators to turn their expertise into mobile and subscription apps that their audience can buy and use, for example a fitness app built around a trainer's programs and coaching. We are looking for a reliable, self-directed virtual assistant to build our creator prospect lists and prepare outreach for these partnerships.



You will not be sending messages or joining calls. Your role covers everything that leads up to that: finding creators who fit our criteria, qualifying them properly, and drafting personalised outreach that reads naturally. We handle the outreach from there.



Because we build products out of a creator's knowledge, the creators we target must have real, teachable expertise. Think coaches, instructors, and educators who genuinely teach their audience something, not accounts that are mainly about looks or lifestyle.



This role will suit someone who is comfortable researching across Instagram and TikTok, has a good eye for quality, and can write clear, natural English.



## What you will do



* Build prospect lists from a defined brief, covering platform, engagement quality, content type, and audience fit

* Qualify each creator properly rather than relying on numbers alone. This means watching their content, checking whether they present well to camera, and assessing whether they have a genuine connection with their audience

* Record the key details in a lead tracker (we will set this up with you)

* Identify the best way to contact each creator and note it

* Draft a short, personalised outreach
 for each qualified creator, referencing something specific about them rather than generic praise

* Keep the pipeline organised and hand over clean, ready-to-use leads and drafts



As a guide, we expect around 7 to 10 qualified creators per day, allowing roughly 15 to 20 minutes to qualify each one properly. Quality of fit matters more than volume.



## Who you are



* Excellent written English. This is essential, as your drafts need to read naturally and professionally

* Confident and efficient navigating Instagram and TikTok, with a good sense of what makes a creator's audience engaged

* Strong research skills. You verify information and do not simply rely on the first result you find

* Organised and accurate. The lead tracker stays clean and correct

* Self-directed. Once you understand the brief, you can work independently without close supervision



## Nice to have



* Experience with influencer or creator research tools (Social Blade, Modash, HypeAuditor, or similar)

* A background in social media, marketing, or partnerships

* Familiarity with Airtable, Notion, or Google Sheets for tracking





## The details



Fully remote

Part-time to start, around 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role

A few hours of daily overlap with New Zealand business hours (NZST)

Rate: USD $5 to $7 per hour, depending on experience

Paid trial before we commit, so both sides can confirm the fit



## How to apply



Please submit your application through our application form: 



Complete both steps below. We only consider applications that include both, submitted via the form above.



1. Record a 60-second video. Introduce yourself, outline your relevant experience, and explain why you are a good fit for this role. It does not need to be polished. We simply want to see how you communicate.



2. Complete a short screening task. Using the brief below, find two creators who fit and draft the outreach
 you would send to one of them.



Context for the task: Voyage builds mobile apps for creators, turning their expertise into a product their audience can buy and use. So we are looking for creators with genuine, teachable skill, whose knowledge could become an app such as a training program, coaching, or structured course.



## Brief for the task:



Platform: Instagram or TikTok

Niche: women's fitness or wellness

Followers: 100k to 250k

Audience: mostly women aged 30 to 45

Must have: educational or instructional content that shows real expertise. For example, a coach breaking down technique, a trainer sharing programs, or an instructor teaching a method

Not a fit: accounts that are mainly modelling, aesthetics, or lifestyle, with no teachable skill behind them



For each creator, provide their handle, their approximate follower count, one line on why their audience looks engaged, and one line on what expertise of theirs could become an app. Then write the outreach
 for one of them, introducing the idea of us building an app around their expertise.



We are not expecting perfection. We want to understand how you think and whether you can follow a brief.

title: E-Commerce Creative Strategist (Direct Response: VSLs, Native Statics, Advertorials)
description:
We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer health brand running paid ads on Meta.



We test creative constantly, and we're hiring a creative strategist to feed the machine.



First, here's what this is not:



- This is not a video editing role.

- This is not a media buying role.

- This is not a graphic design role.

- This is not a VA or social media management role.



This role is pure creative strategy and concept creation.



You research the market, find the angles, write the hooks, script the VSLs, concept the static ads, and write the copy that sells.



Editors and designers produce what you create.



What you'll actually make:



- Full VSL scripts for cold Meta traffic

- Hooks and concept briefs for our editing team

- Native static ads, where the image stops the scroll and your long-form primary text does the selling

- Advertorial and landing page copy

- New angles and test ideas every single week



Our market is older, skeptical, and has been burned by every promise in the book.



If you just read that and started thinking about mechanisms and proof instead of hype, you're probably our person.



Hard requirements:



- Direct response creative work

- Cold paid traffic experience (conversion-focused, not brand awareness, not organic content)

- You can name the brands or funnels you've written for and show the work

- Native static experience is a big plus, but strong VSL writers should absolutely apply.



We operate "work hard, play hard" and often work 5-7 days a week.



Pay is $1,500- $2,500/month USD starting, based on skill, plus performance bonuses when your ads win (details shared in the interview).



Our starting range does not exceed that number.



There is real room to GROW beyond it once you prove you can produce winners... but if you need more to start, please do not apply.



One more thing.



Your application is the first ad you will ever write for us.



The product is you.



The customer is us.



We read every single response, and we move FAST when we find someone good.



This is a REMOTE position.

title: Bookeeper |Finance Administrator
description:
ROLE TITLE: Bookkeeper / Finance Administrator (Offshore, Part-Time)



Hours: Approx. 2 hours/day, 5 days/week (~10 hours/week) extending to more hours.

Reports to: GM — Sonya Keenan

Entity: Changing Habits (Divitiae Health Pty Ltd t/a Changing Habits)

Location: Remote / Offshore (via agency)

Start Date: Target: end of July / start of August 2026



ABOUT THE ROLE

Changing Habits is a fast-moving ecommerce brand on Shopify with ~1,100+ orders per month. We operate

across three core platforms — Shopify, CIN7, and Xero — and need a dedicated bookkeeper who can keep our

numbers clean, current, and trustworthy on a daily basis.

This is not a monthly catch-up role. We run the business day to day and we need someone who does the same

with our financials. If something doesn't reconcile, we need to know within the day — not at the end of the

month.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Daily reconciliation of bank accounts, Shopify settlements, and PayPal/gateway deposits in Xero

• Match and clear supplier invoices against purchase orders in CIN7 and Xero

• Flag anomalies, missing settlements, or overdue payables immediately — not at end of month

• Keep Xero accounts payable current and accurate (accrual basis, not cash)

• Cross-check incoming invoices against expected amounts and raise queries where figures don't align

• Support transition to accrual-based COGS reporting so gross profit reflects actual stock sold, not invoices

paid

• Assist with preparation of data and reports to support BAS lodgement

• General financial and admin including forms, follow-ups, and document management as directed



WHAT YOU NEED

• Proven bookkeeping experience — you must be confident with debits, credits, bank reconciliations, and

accounts payable is essential

• Xero — strong working knowledge is essential

• Ecommerce experience essential — you must understand how online store settlements, refunds, and order

flows work

• Experience with a stock management / inventory system (CIN7 or equivalent) – preferred however can be

trained

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic financial analysis — you'll extract, review, and flag data regularly

• Detail-oriented and proactive — if something doesn't look right, you raise it the same day

Highly Valued

• Shopify — experience reading and reconciling sales data, settlements, and payout reports

• CIN7 — direct experience preferred; we can train the right person on CIN7 specifics

• Experience supporting a small ecommerce team where you own the day-to-day financial picture



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR

This is not an accounting or CFO role. We don't need tax strategy or high-level financial planning. We need

clean books, daily reconciliation, and someone who takes ownership of keeping the numbers right. You won't be

managing payroll however assisting with this.



HOW IT WORKS

• Offshore role placed, flexible hours

• Tasks are routine and structured — you'll have a defined set of daily and weekly responsibilities

• Day-to-day management and task direction sits with Ashur (GM)

• Charity (Finance & Operations Manager) retains oversight of payments and payroll

• Approximately 2 hours/day — timing flexible, ideally afternoons AEST so settlements from the prior day

are available

• Over time, this role may expand to include CIN7 inventory support as a backup to our operations

coordinator



KEY SYSTEMS

Xero Accounting, reconciliation, AP/AR Essential

Shopify Ecommerce sales, settlements, reports Essential

CIN7 Inventory, purchase orders, COGS Valued (trainable)

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets / MS Sharepoint Essential

Reporting, analysis, data review Essential



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

•	Cover letter — why they want to join and what they will specifically bring to the role

•	Resume / CV

•	A short video (2–3 minutes) — talk to us like you are already in the room

 Marketplace

mbers are placed on standby — a temporary pause, not a termination. You stay part of our team and are first in line to be called back when the next surge hits (we expect these regularly).

etings)

title: Brand Strategist & Copywriter
description:
Are you the kind of person who can read a brand brief and immediately hear the story underneath it? Do you get genuinely excited about finding the exact words that make a brand feel unmistakably like itself, not generic or templated and certainly not AI? And do you think beyond the document... about whether the client can actually use what you've created once you're done



Then keep reading...



About I for Design Studio:

We're a boutique brand and web design studio based on the Sunshine Coast, QLD Australia, led by Indiah (Creative Director). We work with premium service-based businesses. Think interior designers, lawyers, allied health professionals, and creative studios who care deeply about how their brand shows up in the world.



The design work is refined, intentional, and personality-led. The brand strategy and copy behind it needs to match that standard exactly.



The opportunity:

This is a gig-based EOI, not an ongoing role *yet*. We're looking to build a relationship with a brand strategist and copywriter (if such a unicorn exists) who we can bring in on a per-project basis as the workload requires. If the fit is right, there's real potential for this to grow into something more regular over time.



What you'll work on:

1. Brand strategy documents: positioning, audience research, competitor analysis, brand personality and messaging frameworks

2. Tone of voice development: defining how a brand sounds and giving it a voice that actually feels human

3. Website copy: homepage through to internal pages, written to convert without sounding like everyone else

4. Brand messaging: taglines, brand story, key messages, value propositions

5. Brand guidelines that are genuinely usable: written in plain language so clients can maintain their own voice confidently after handover

6. Supporting with EDM copy, social captions, or other brand-adjacent writing when needed



What's in it for you:

• A creative director who has strong aesthetic and strategic instincts, meaning you won't be briefed vaguely and left to guess

• A creative director who genuinely wants your strategic input. Yes, your ideas and instincts are welcome and encouraged here, not just your execution

• Inspiring, well-positioned clients across premium service industries

• Flexible, project-based work that fits around your other commitments

• A studio that values craft, honesty, and doing things properly



You're a fit if you:

• Have at least 3 years experience in brand strategy, copywriting, or both, ideally in a creative service or agency environment

• Understand the difference between a brand voice and a writing style, and know how to build both from scratch

• Write in clear, confident, human English that doesn't sound like it came from a template (or worse, AI)

• Can translate research, strategy, and client conversations into copy that actually moves people

• Understand that strategy and copy only work if the client can actually USE them. You write guidelines that are clear, practical, and easy to implement, not just impressive documents that sit in a folder and never get opened again

• Don't just complete the brief, you improve it. You bring ideas, spot gaps, and flag opportunities we haven't thought of yet. If you can see a better way to position a client or a piece of copy that would land harder, you say so

• Are comfortable working autonomously from a brief and delivering polished work without hand-holding

• Communicate proactively, ask smart questions upfront, and flag anything unclear before it becomes a problem

• Are available for calls and feedback during AEST business hours when needed



Bonus points for:

• Experience working with premium service-based businesses like lawyers, health professionals, interior designers, creative studios

• Understanding of brand identity and how copy and visual design work together

• Ability to do both strategy AND copy (potentially rare, but very welcome)



How to apply:

 
 with the subject line: "I'm your next brand strategist and copywriter"



Please include:

• A short note about who you are and why this work appeals to you

• One or two examples of brand strategy or copy you've created that you're genuinely proud of and a sentence on why

• Your CV or portfolio link

• Your availability and preferred rate per project or per hour in USD



**Important note: please write your application in your own words. We use AI tools in our everyday processes and we're not against them, but if your application reads like it was written entirely by AI, it won't be considered. This role is about human thinking, human voice, and human creativity. We'd love for you to show us yours!



Due to the volume of applications, we're only able to respond to candidates we'd like to take further. If you don't hear from us, please know we appreciate you taking the time to apply.

Coastal Interiors Co is a family-owned construction and cabinetry business based in Perth, Western Australia.

We specialise in high-end commercial fit-outs, luxury retail spaces, office refurbishments, custom cabinetry and residential renovations. As our business continues to grow, we're investing in the right people and systems to build a business that's organised, efficient and positioned for long-term success.

We're looking for an experienced Finance & Administration Coordinator who enjoys bringing order to the details. Someone who takes pride in accurate bookkeeping, organised systems and helping a business run smoothly.

This is a long-term opportunity to become a trusted member of a small, supportive team where your work genuinely makes a difference.



WHY JOIN US?

You'll work directly with the business owners and become an important part of our growing team.

We value trust, initiative and open communication. We don't micromanage—we hire good people, support them and trust them to do their best work.

Because Perth and the Philippines share the same time zone, you'll work normal business hours alongside us, making collaboration simple.

We're looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity. As your skills and responsibilities grow, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and continue growing with the business.

This is a full-time, long-term independent contractor position working exclusively with Coastal Interiors Co.

Your primary focus will be keeping our finance and administration organised, accurate and running efficiently. You'll maintain our Xero records, manage day-to-day administration and become the person we rely on to keep things running behind the scenes.

As you become established in the role, you'll assist with our transition to Buildern, help maintain our business systems, contribute to documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs) and support continuous improvements across the business.

This role is designed to grow over time. We'll support you as you learn our systems and gradually introduce new responsibilities as your confidence and experience develop.

 inbox and calendar

- You understand how our business operates and are becoming a reliable part of the team.



After Three Months:

- Our accounts are accurate and up to date.

- Our administration is organised and running smoothly.

- You're confidently managing your core responsibilities with minimal supervision.



After Twelve Months:

- You're a trusted member of our team.

- Our finance and administration systems are reliable and well organised.

- You're contributing ideas that help improve the way we work.

- What We're Looking For



Essential:

- At least 5 years' bookkeeping or finance administration experience

- Australian bookkeeping or payroll experience

- Strong Xero experience

- Excellent organisational and time management skills

- High attention to detail

- Excellent written English

- Confidence using Microsoft 365, Excel and cloud-based software

- Previous experience working remotely



Highly Regarded:

- Experience supporting business owners directly



The Right Person Will Be:

- Reliable and trustworthy

- Organised and proactive

- Comfortable working independently

- Curious and eager to learn

- Respectful, approachable and easy to work with

- Someone who genuinely cares about doing quality work



What We Offer:

- USD $900–$1,300 per month, depending on experience

- Annual salary reviews

- Software subscriptions provided

- Long-term stability with one growing business

- Direct access to the business owners

- A supportive and respectful team environment

- Opportunities to grow into a broader operations role over time



As this is an independent contractor position, paid leave is not included and public holidays will follow your local calendar.



A Note About This Role:

We're looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of our team.

Because this is a full-time position, we ask that your working hours are dedicated exclusively to Coastal Interiors Co. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship with one business rather than dividing their time between multiple clients during business hours.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller/Appointment Setter
description:
About Us

Palmetto Home Group is a U.S.-based real estate investment company in Columbia, South Carolina. We buy houses directly from homeowners for cash: primarily distressed, inherited, and/or tired-landlord properties. We're a small, growing operation run by the founder and a U.S.-based acquisitions manager. We're adding our first dedicated cold caller.

This is not a churn-and-burn shop. We pay competitively, provide clean skip-traced data, give you a real auto-dialer, train you properly, and expect long-term performance. If you want a stable, well-run U.S. client for the next few years, keep reading.



The Role

You're our first voice on the phone. Your only job is to call homeowners in Columbia, SC, qualify them using our UMBC framework, and book a scheduled callback.

You will NOT: make offers, quote prices, negotiate, or run full discovery calls.

-Work a pre-loaded list of motivated-seller leads (e.g. probate, pre-foreclosure, tired landlord, absentee owner)

-Fluent, natural English with a neutral or light accent...you'll be talking to American homeowners, often older

-Prior cold calling or appointment setting experience (real estate strongly preferred)

-Reliable computer, headset, and stable high-speed internet

-Able to work U.S. business hours (Eastern time)

Pay

$5–$7/hr depending on experience (higher end for proven real estate setters)

$50 bonus per deal that closes from an appointment you booked

Paid weekly. Raises tied to performance after the trial period.



How To Apply (read carefully — applications that skip these are deleted)
