title: Australian Bookkeeper & Finance Manager (Shopify & Xero Specialist)
description:
Hi,



We're Brew Methods, a Melbourne-based specialty coffee company looking for an experienced Finance Manager to build and manage our finance function from the ground up.



This role is only suitable for candidates with previous experience managing an Australian Shopify-based businesses. You must be comfortable working within Shopify, extracting and reconciling reports, understanding Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, payment gateways, Shopify Capital, and ensuring GST is accurately recorded at the product level.



We currently do not have any accounting software in place. We're looking for someone to set up Xero from the ground up, integrate it with our Shopify store and business bank accounts, and then take ownership of our finance and bookkeeping processes on an ongoing basis.



Initially, this role will involve implementing Xero, connecting Shopify, our business bank accounts and payment providers, organising our financial records, establishing payroll and superannuation, and creating accurate financial systems from day one. Once everything is established, the role will become an ongoing position of approximately 8–12 hours per month, with opportunities to grow as the business expands.



Accuracy is extremely important to us. We sell a combination of GST-free and taxable products, so we require someone who can accurately reconcile Shopify sales at the product level—not simply record Shopify payouts into accounting software.



Key Responsibilities

Set up and configure Xero from the ground up.

Integrate Xero with Shopify, business bank accounts and payment providers.

Build and maintain accurate finance and bookkeeping processes.

Import and organise historical financial data where required.

Reconcile Shopify sales at the product level, ensuring GST-free and taxable products are recorded accurately.

Reconcile Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, discounts, payment gateways and Shopify Capital repayments.

Perform weekly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations.

Manage Australian GST coding and prepare BAS working papers.

Set up and manage payroll for employees and directors.

Process PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting.

Prepare financial reports for our Australian accountant.

Liaise directly with our accountant when required.

Organise receipts and invoices.

Provide simple monthly summaries showing profit, expenses, cash flow and GST obligations.

Continuously improve our finance systems and processes.



Requirements

Minimum 3 years' bookkeeping or finance experience.

Extensive experience working with Australian businesses.

Previous experience managing the finances of Australian Shopify-based businesses (essential).

Strong working knowledge of Shopify, including extracting financial reports, reconciling Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, discounts, payment gateways and Shopify Capital.

Experience reconciling Shopify sales at the product level, ensuring GST-free and taxable products are accurately recorded.

Strong understanding of Australian GST, BAS preparation, PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting.

Strong experience using Xero, including setting up new organisations from scratch.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

Able to explain financial matters in plain English.

Comfortable communicating directly with Australian accountants.



About Brew Methods



Brew Methods is a premium specialty coffee company based in Melbourne, Australia.



We roast and sell specialty coffee, brewing equipment and coffee subscriptions through our Shopify store, serving customers across Australia and around the world.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our business and take ownership of our finance function as we continue to grow.



To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your experience managing the finances of Australian Shopify-based businesses.

2. Describe the most similar Australian Shopify business you've worked with and your responsibilities.

3. Have you previously set up Xero for an Australian Shopify business? 

4. Have you managed Australian payroll, PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting? Please describe your experience.

5. Have you prepared BAS working papers for an Australian accountant? 

6. Tell us about a client whose bookkeeping was similar to ours.

7. What hourly rate are you seeking?



Please include the words "Coffee is life" at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the entire job description.



Please begin your application by telling us about a similar Australian Shopify business you've managed. This helps us identify candidates with relevant hands-on experience.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Lead Generation and Outreach Specialist (Remote)
description:
Voyage is a growth agency that builds digital products for creators. We partner with creators to turn their expertise into mobile and subscription apps that their audience can buy and use, for example a fitness app built around a trainer's programs and coaching.



We are looking for a lead generation specialist to research and identify the right creators for us to partner with, and to prepare personalised outreach that opens conversations.



Please read this part carefully. This is a sales-focused research and outreach role. It is not social media management, content creation, or influencer campaign work. If you enjoy prospecting, list building, and tracking down exactly the right person to contact, you will do well here. If you are looking for a social media or influencer marketing job, this is not the right role.



What this role is, and is not



This role is:



* Researching and building targeted lists of prospects (creators) that fit a clear brief

* Qualifying each one to d
 whether they are genuinely the right fit

* Writing personalised outreach to start a conversation





This role is not:



* Managing social media accounts or creating content

* Running influencer or advertising campaigns

* Community management, or replying to comments and DMs on our behalf





What you will do



* Build targeted prospect lists from a defined brief, covering platform, engagement quality, content type, and audience fit

* Qualify each creator properly rather than relying on numbers alone. This means watching their content, checking whether they present well to camera, and assessing whether they have a genuine connection with their audience

* Record the key details in a lead tracker (we will set this up with you)

* Identify the best way to contact each creator and note it

* Draft a short, personalised outreach message for each qualified prospect, referencing something specific about them rather than generic praise

* Keep the pipeline organised and hand over clean, ready-to-use leads and drafts



As a guide, we expect around 7 to 10 qualified prospects per day, allowing roughly 15 to 20 minutes to qualify each one properly. Quality of fit matters more than volume.



Because we build products out of a creator's knowledge, the creators we target must have real, teachable expertise. Think coaches, instructors, and educators who genuinely teach their audience something, not accounts that are mainly about looks or lifestyle.





Who you are



* Experience in lead generation, prospecting, appointment setting, sales development, or cold outreach. This is the background that fits best

* Excellent written English. This is essential, as your outreach needs to read naturally and persuasively

* Confident and efficient researching online and across Instagram and TikTok, with a good sense of what makes a prospect a strong fit

* Strong research skills. You verify information and do not simply rely on the first result you find

* Organised and accurate. The lead tracker stays clean and correct

* Self-directed. Once you understand the brief, you can work independently without close supervision





Nice to have



* Experience with lead generation or research tools, or a CRM

* Familiarity with creator research tools (Social Blade, Modash, HypeAuditor, or similar)

* Familiarity with Airtable, Notion, or Google Sheets for tracking





The details



* Fully remote

* Part-time to start, around 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role

* A few hours of daily overlap with New Zealand business hours (NZST)

* Rate: USD $5 to $7 per hour, depending on experience

* Paid trial before we commit, so both sides can confirm the fit





How to apply



Please submit your application through our application form: 



Complete both steps below. We only consider applications that include both, submitted via the form above.



1. Record a 60-second video. Introduce yourself, outline your relevant experience, and explain why you are a good fit for this role. It does not need to be polished. We simply want to see how you communicate.



2. Complete a short screening task. This mirrors the actual work. Using the brief below, find two creators who fit and draft the outreach
 you would send to one of them.



Context for the task: Voyage builds mobile apps for creators, turning their expertise into a product their audience can buy and use. So we are looking for creators with genuine, teachable skill, whose knowledge could become an app such as a training program, coaching, or structured course.



Brief for the task:



Platform: Instagram or TikTok

Niche: women's fitness or wellness

Followers: 100k to 250k

Audience: mostly women aged 30 to 45

Must have: educational or instructional content that shows real expertise. For example, a coach breaking down technique, a trainer sharing programs, or an instructor teaching a method

Not a fit: accounts that are mainly modelling, aesthetics, or lifestyle, with no teachable skill behind them





For each creator, provide their handle, their approximate follower count, one line on why their audience looks engaged, and one line on what expertise of theirs could become an app. Then write the outreach
 for one of them, introducing the idea of us building an app around their expertise.



We are not expecting perfection. We want to understand how you think and whether you can follow a brief.

title: Fulltime Social Media Manager Needed!
description:
We're a Los Angeles–based marketing agency running social media for a portfolio of restaurant and hospitality brands. We're hiring a Social Media Manager who can own both the relationship side and the content side of multiple Instagram and TikTok accounts, someone organized, proactive, and comfortable juggling several brands at once.



This is a hands-on execution role. Your day starts with a triage routine: checking overnight messages, updating tracking sheets, and clearing anything urgent before production work begins. 



Core responsibilities include:

Influencer outreach & relationships: Running end-to-end outreach to approved influencers across Instagram and TikTok (engagement, DMs, negotiation, and follow-up), tracking every touchpoint in dedicated Google Sheets, following up on deliverables after visits, and helping maintain long-term relationships with top creators.



Inbound communications & inquiry management — Monitoring and responding to DMs across platforms (dietary questions, hours, reservations), filtering
 inboxes for valuable opportunities (events, media, PR, partnerships), logging every inquiry in a tracking database, and escalating important or oversized requests to management.



Content calendar & publishing: Maintaining content calendars for multiple brands and making sure every post is fully prepped, reviewed, and ready to post.



Short-form video editing: Stitching raw footage into Instagram Reels and TikToks with basic motion, text, and graphics, using reference videos and shot lists as guides, and resizing/adapting content per platform.



Social Media Account Maintenance & light graphic design: Replying to comments, acknowledging tags, resharing user content, and designing simple promotional graphics (event flyers, happy-hour posts, giveaways) using brand assets.



This is a full-time, long-term position, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST (Los Angeles time), Monday–Friday, fully remote, reporting to the agency owner. 



We move fast, document everything, and value people who follow detailed processes, take feedback well, and don't need to be chased.





Influencer outreach & inbound message management: Proven experience DMing and negotiating with influencers/creators on Instagram and TikTok, plus responding to inbound DMs and
 inquiries professionally and escalating the right ones. Disciplined about logging every contact in tracking sheets.



Content operations & short-form video editing: Able to manage multi-brand content calendars, write strong on-brand captions and hashtags, and edit Reels/TikToks from raw footage (CapCut, Premiere, or similar), including resizing for each platform.



Highly organized, coachable, and spreadsheet-fluent: Comfortable living in Google Sheets, following written SOPs precisely, working independently through a full shift, and applying feedback quickly. Strong written English is essential.

title: Content Strategist + Short-Form Video Editor (Reels/TikTok)
description:
This is a two-part role for one person who is genuinely good at both halves:



1. Content Strategy & Trend Research. You live on Instagram, TikTok, and
. You know what's trending right now, you can research a brand and its competitors, and — most importantly — you can look at a trending video or format and correctly d
 "this one fits this brand, and here's how I'd adapt it." That judgment is the most important skill in this role.



2. Short-Form Editing. You edit Reels and TikToks that are clean and simple — not flashy or over-edited. Most of our clients are lifestyle brands who want natural, polished-but-real content. You can also build a strong reel out of an existing folder of a client's raw content while staying true to their brand.



We do NOT need extravagant, effect-heavy edits. We need taste, brand awareness, and reliable execution.



What You'll Do:



- Research trends across Instagram, TikTok, and
 and spot what's worth jumping on

- Do brand and competitor research to understand each client's world

- Take trending formats/audios and adapt them into ideas that fit a specific brand

- Plan reels and short-form content for multiple client brands

- Edit clean, simple, lifestyle-style Reels (captions, light text, good pacing, right audio, sound fx, if needed)

- Build content from a client's existing raw footage/photo library, on-brand

- Bring ideas to the table — don't wait to be told exactly what to make



Requirements:



Must have:

- Real understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and
 — you use them daily and get why things go viral

- Proven ability to spot trends and adapt them to a brand (not just repost what's popular)

- Solid short-form editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, Edits, or similar) with a clean, natural style

- A portfolio of Reels/TikToks you've edited — lifestyle/clean work preferred

- Strong written English and proactive communication

- Reliable internet, self-motivated, hits deadlines without micromanagement

- Some overlap with US Eastern (EST) hours



Nice to have:

- Agency or multi-client experience

- Comfortable using AI tools thoughtfully (see the note below)

- Basic graphic/Canva skills



On AI: We want someone who knows how to use AI to work faster — but who does NOT outsource their thinking to it. We care about genuine, original judgment in the work you submit. Using AI as a tool is great; submitting generic AI output is not.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio — must include Reels/TikToks you personally edited (links preferred)

2. 3 examples of short-form videos you've edited (links)

3. Your rate (per hour or per month) and hours/week you're available

4. One line: How do you use AI in your work — and where do you choose NOT to use it?



Hiring Process:



1. Application review

2. Short video call (Google Meet)

3. Paid test project (compensated — real brand, real trend research + one edited reel)

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications



## About Safety 1st Electrical Services



Safety 1st Electrical Services, Inc. is a growing electrical contracting company serving residential and commercial clients throughout the Metro Atlanta area. We are committed to providing professional, safety-focused electrical services while delivering an exceptional client experience.



As our company continues to grow, we are strengthening our internal systems, leadership structure, team accountability, and day-to-day operations. We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly organized Executive Assistant who can help the owner manage priorities, coordinate team activities, and ensure important responsibilities are completed accurately and on time.



## Position Overview



The Executive Assistant will serve as a strategic administrative and operational partner to the company owner. This individual will help organize the owner’s priorities, coordinate communication between departments, create and track assignments, prepare reports, document meetings, and ensure that important follow-up items do not get overlooked.



This is not a passive administrative role. The ideal candidate will be proactive, comfortable taking ownership, able to anticipate needs, and skilled at holding projects and tea
mbers accountable in a professional manner.



A primary objective of this position is to help Safety 1st Electrical Services build stronger team operations, improve communication, and establish consistent accountability throughout the company.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Executive Support and Priority Management



* Manage the owner’s calendar, appointments, meetings, reminders, and daily priorities.

* Organize the owner’s
 inbox and identify messages requiring immediate attention, follow-up, delegation, or documentation.

* Prepare the owner for meetings by organizing relevant documents, reports, client information, and action items.

* Assist the owner with planning, decision-making, and execution of company priorities.

* Protect the owner’s time by helping prioritize requests, meetings, projects, and administrative responsibilities.

* Maintain confidentiality when handling company, employee, client, and financial information.



### Team Operations and Accountability



* Create clear work assignments for the Client Care Coordinator and other tea
mbers as directed by the owner.

* Document assignment details, deadlines, priorities, expected outcomes, and responsible parties.

* Monitor assigned tasks and follow up with tea
mbers to confirm completion.

* Maintain accountability trackers, project lists, recurring task lists, and company action-item reports.

* Identify overdue responsibilities, communication gaps, and operational concerns before they become larger problems.

* Provide the owner with regular updates regarding completed, pending, delayed, and high-priority assignments.

* Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures for recurring administrative and operational responsibilities.



### Meetings and Strategic Planning



* Participate in leadership, strategy, operations, and tea
etings.

* Prepare meeting agendas and organize supporting information before meetings.

* Take accurate and detailed meeting notes.

* Clearly document decisions, assignments, deadlines, and next steps.

* Distribute meeting notes and action items to the appropriate tea
mbers.

* Follow up after meetings to ensure assigned responsibilities are completed.

* Assist the owner in turning strategic ideas into organized plans, timelines, and measurable assignments.



### CRM, Scheduling, Estimates, and Client Follow-Up



* Review and help maintain accurate client information within the company’s CRM and service-management systems.

* Monitor appointments, estimates, service requests, client follow-ups, and open opportunities.

* Assist with coordinating the service calendar and ensuring appointments contain complete client and project information.

* Review outstanding estimates and help organize follow-up assignments for the Client Care Coordinator.

* Monitor client communication to ensure inquiries and follow-ups are handled professionally and within company expectations.

* Help identify missed opportunities, inactive leads, delayed estimates, and clients requiring additional communication.

* Support the preparation, organization, and delivery of professional estimates, proposals, and project documents.

* Maintain accurate records of client communication, appointment status, estimate status, and next actions.



### Inbox, Calendar, and Communication Management



* Draft and organize professional
s, client messages, internal announcements, and follow-up communication.

* Monitor important incoming communication and ensure that urgent matters are escalated appropriately.

* Coordinate meetings with clients, employees, vendors, applicants, and business partners.

* Maintain accurate calendar details, including appointment locations, contact information, meeting objectives, and required preparation.

* Help ensure communication between the owner, Client Care Coordinator, field team, vendors, and clients remains clear and organized.

* Represent Safety 1st Electrical Services professionally in written and verbal communication.



### Bookkeeping, Reporting, and Administrative Records



* Assist with organizing bookkeeping records, receipts, invoices, deposits, payments, and supporting financial documentation.

* Help monitor the accuracy and completion of administrative and financial records.

* Assist with reconciling information between payment processors, accounting software, CRM records, and bank deposits.

* Prepare recurring operational, financial, sales, scheduling, and performance reports for the owner.

* Maintain organized electronic records within Google Drive and other company systems.

* Assist with tracking company expenses, vendor charges, outstanding balances, permits, deposits, and project payment schedules.

* Coordinate with the company’s bookkeeper or CPA when documentation or clarification is required.

* Identify missing records, unusual discrepancies, or incomplete financial information and bring them to the owner’s attention.



### Hiring and Employee Administration



* Assist with posting job openings and organizing candidate applications.

* Conduct initial applicant screening based on established requirements.

* Coordinate interviews and maintain communication with qualified applicants.

* Prepare interview schedules, candidate summaries, screening notes, and follow-up assignments.

* Assist with onboarding documentation, employee records, training schedules, and company policy acknowledgments.

* Maintain organized and confidential employee files.

* Help track attendance, performance expectations, training requirements, and employee follow-up items.

* Support the owner with administrative preparation for employee reviews, coaching meetings, and accountability conversations.



### Vendor and Project Coordination



* Communicate with vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, marketing providers, and other business partners.

* Request and organize quotes, invoices, product information, delivery updates, and supporting documents.

* Track vendor commitments, deadlines, outstanding requests, and required follow-ups.

* Assist with coordinating materials, permits, project documentation, and administrative requirements.

* Help ensure the owner receives the information needed to make timely purchasing and operational decisions.

* Maintain organized records for vendor agreements, subscriptions, company services, and recurring expenses.



## Required Qualifications



* At least five years of professional experience supporting an executive, business owner, senior leader, or management team.

* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar position.

* Experience managing calendars, inboxes, meetings, assignments, reports, and confidential business information.

* Strong project coordination and task-management experience.

* Demonstrated ability to follow up with tea
mbers and maintain accountability without constant supervision.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong professional communication, grammar, and documentation skills.

* Experience preparing meeting agendas, meeting notes, action-item lists, reports, and professional business correspondence.

* Experience working with CRM platforms, scheduling systems, cloud-based documents, and task-management tools.

* Working knowledge of bookkeeping records, invoices, payments, financial reports, and administrative documentation.

* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive.

* Reliable computer, secure internet connection, professional home workspace, and dependable backup internet or power solution.

* Ability to work during agreed hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting a construction, home-service, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, field-service, or trade-based company.

* Experience working with QuickBooks Online, Stripe, GoHighLevel, Markate, MightyCall, or similar systems.

* Experience coordinating remote employees and field-service teams.

* Experience assisting with hiring, onboarding, employee records, and performance tracking.

* Experience creating standard operating procedures, accountability systems, dashboards, and recurring reports.

* Experience working directly with entrepreneurs or owners of growing small businesses.

* Basic understanding of sales pipelines, estimates, service appointments, client follow-up, and project payment schedules.



## Ideal Candidate Profile



The successful candidate will be:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive rather than reactive.

* Comfortable working directly with a fast-moving business owner.

* Able to turn verbal instructions and strategic discussions into organized assignments and written plans.

* Confident following up with employees, vendors, and clients.

* Professional, respectful, and firm when enforcing deadlines and expectations.

* Capable of identifying problems and presenting potential solutions.

* Able to manage multiple priorities without losing track of important details.

* Dependable and consistent with excellent follow-through.

* Discreet when handling confidential business and employee information.

* Interested in helping build systems that allow the company to grow successfully.



## Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by the Executive Assistant’s ability to:



* Keep the owner’s calendar, inbox, priorities, and follow-up responsibilities organized.

* Ensure assignments are clearly communicated, documented, tracked, and completed.

* Reduce missed deadlines, incomplete follow-ups, and communication gaps.

* Improve accountability among administrative and operational tea
mbers.

* Maintain accurate CRM, scheduling, financial, hiring, and administrative records.

* Produce timely and accurate meeting notes, reports, and action-item summaries.

* Help the owner remain focused on high-level leadership, sales, and company growth.

* Create greater consistency, organization, and operational stability throughout the company.



## Application Requirements



Candidates should submit the following:



1. A current résumé outlining at least five years of relevant executive support experience.

2. A brief introduction explaining why they are a strong fit for Safety 1st Electrical Services.

3. A short video introducing themselves and describing their experience supporting an executive or business owner.

4. A description of the systems and software they have previously used.

5. An example of how they have improved team accountability or business operations in a previous role.

6. Their expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

7. Their availability to work hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant (Cold Calling & Lead Generation)
description:
PLEASE
 ME YOUR RESUME. We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Real Estate Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is an excellent English speaker with proven experience in real estate cold calling, lead generation, and objection handling. Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls to homeowners, identifying motivated sellers, and setting qualified appointments. We will train, provide scripts, and a crm. WILL GIVE BONUS FOR EACH QUALIFIED APPT MADE



Responsibilities:



* Make high-volume outbound cold calls to homeowners using provided scripts and dialers.

* Build rapport with property owners and maintain professional, engaging conversations.

* Identify motivated sellers and qualify leads based on our criteria.

* Effectively handle objections and keep conversations moving toward an appointment.

* Schedule appointments for acquisitions specialists.

* Accurately update CRM with call notes, lead status, and follow-up tasks.

* Follow up with prospects as needed to nurture potential opportunities.

* Meet or exceed daily call and lead generation goals.

* Communicate regularly with the team regarding lead quality and campaign performance.



Qualifications:



* Minimum 1-2 years of experience as a Real Estate Virtual Assistant or Real Estate Cold Caller.

* Excellent spoken and written English with a neutral or easily understandable accent.

* Strong objection-handling and persuasion skills.

* Confident speaking with homeowners and building rapport quickly.

* Experience with real estate investing (wholesaling, acquisitions, dispositions, or lead generation) is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with CRMs such as Podio, GoHighLevel, REsimpli, Salesforce, or similar platforms.

* Experience using dialers such as Mojo, BatchDialer, CallTools, ReadyMode/XenCall, or similar.

* Highly organized, dependable, and self-motivated.

* Reliable high-speed internet connection, quality headset, and a quiet workspace.



Preferred Skills:



* Knowledge of seller motivation and property qualification.

* Experience setting appointments for acquisitions teams.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.



 Performance Expectations:



* Complete assigned daily call volume.

* Generate qualified motivated seller leads.

* Maintain accurate CRM records.

* Consistently meet appointment-setting and conversion goals.

* Demonstrate professionalism and excellent customer service on every call.



What We're Looking For:



We're seeking someone who is confident, resilient, and not discouraged by rejection. Success in this role requires persistence, excellent communication skills, and the ability to turn conversations into opportunities. If you enjoy talking with people, handling objections, and helping generate new business, we'd love to hear from you.



**To Apply:** Please include your resume, a short voice recording introducing yourself in English (1-2 minutes), and describe your experience with real estate cold calling, the CRMs and dialers you've used, and your average daily call volume and appointment-setting results. We typically are calling expireds, cancelled, withdrawn, "Z Buyers", and sometimes even cold calling "empty nesters".

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & P&L Reporting Specialist
description:
QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper for RV Rental and Vacation Rental (AirBnb) Businesses



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented part time bookkeeper to organize and clean up our financial records for 2025 and then manage our bookkeeping on an ongoing monthly basis.  In addition you will be required to prepare and provide P and L Statements



We operate two businesses in the United States:



An RV rental business with multiple vehicles

A short-term vacation rental business with one property.



You would use QuickBooks Online. We need someone who can accurately categorize transactions, reconcile accounts and produce clear profit-and-loss reports that help us understand how each business is performing.



This will begin as a part-time position; in the beginning, there will be more work and therefore more hours to do (as you will provide P and L Statements for 2025.  Once caught up, demand and hours will be slightly 



Initial Project: 2025 Bookkeeping Cleanup



Your first responsibility will be to organize and complete our bookkeeping for 2025.



This will include:



Reviewing and categorizing income and expenses

Reconciling bank and credit-card accounts

Identifying duplicate, missing or incorrectly categorized transactions

Separating personal and business expenses when necessary

Organizing transactions between the RV rental and vacation rental businesses

Producing accurate 2025 profit-and-loss statements

Preparing the books for review by our U.S.-based accountant

Creating a list of any missing documents or questions that require the owner’s input

Ongoing Monthly Responsibilities



After the 2025 cleanup is complete, responsibilities will include:



Maintaining QuickBooks Online

Categorizing transactions weekly or monthly

Reconciling all bank and credit-card accounts

Recording income from booking platforms and direct reservations

Matching deposits with the correct reservations

Reviewing expenses for accuracy

Producing monthly profit-and-loss statements

Producing separate reports for each business

Tracking income and expenses by RV, property or business category when possible

Identifying unusual expenses, missing payments or discrepancies

Keeping the books organized and ready for tax preparation

Providing a brief monthly summary explaining the results

Types of Transactions You May Work With



Our income and expenses may involve platforms and categories such as:



Airbnb

Vrbo

Outdoorsy

RVshare

Direct bookings

Cleaning expenses

Repairs and maintenance

Vehicle expenses

Insurance

Registration and licensing

Property utilities

Supplies and guest amenities

Platform commissions and processing fees

Security deposits

Refunds and damage charges

title: Creative Virtual Assistant & Wedding Culling Assistant (Remote)
description:
Hi! I'm Cescily, the owner of Hyde Photo & Film. I'm a wedding photographer looking for a creative, dependable assistant to help me behind the scenes as my business continues to grow.



This is much more than a typical virtual assistant position. I'm looking for someone who genuinely appreciates beautiful imagery, enjoys organization, and wants to become an important part of a creative business. No wedding photography experience is required,  provide training, detailed workflows, and all of the systems you'll need to succeed.



Your responsibilities may include:

Culling and curating wedding galleries (approximately 3,000–7,000 images per wedding)

Straightening, cropping, and photoshopping images in Lightroom Classic (no editing required)

Assembling Instagram Reels and TikToks from footage I provide

Creating Canva graphics, guides, and client resources

Writing blog posts and helping keep my website updated

Organizing and updating information inside my client management software

Other creative and administrative tasks as my business grows



Every month looks a little different, which keeps the work interesting!

Who I'm Looking For

The right person is someone who:

- Has a strong appreciation for photography, storytelling, and creativity

- Enjoys looking through thousands of wedding images and selecting the very best 
nts

- Has an artistic eye and good attention to detail

- Is organized, dependable, and consistently meets deadlines

- Learns quickly and enjoys improving systems and workflows

- Is proactive and enjoys figuring things out independently while asking questions when needed

- Communicates clearly in English

- Is trustworthy and able to handle client information confidentially

- Has experience with Canva, social media, or other creative software (a plus, but not required)

- Loves movies, music, photography, design, or other creative arts

- I value character, work ethic, and reliability far more than an impressive résumé.



Weekly Schedule

- One requirement for this position is availability every Sunday and Monday (Mountain Time) to complete wedding culling. Finished galleries must be ready for me by Tuesday at 7:00 AM MST.

- Outside of those deadlines, much of the work can be completed on your own schedule.



Hours & Growth

- This position starts at approximately 10 hours per week, although some weeks may be busier than others.



My goal is to begin with a smaller workload while we both become comfortable working together. As trust grows and my business continues to expand, I plan to increase both responsibilities and hours.

The ideal candidate is someone interested in growing into a long-term part-time—and potentially full-time—position. During busy wedding season, full-time work is very possible.

I believe in rewarding people who care about their work. Strong performance, commitment, and growth are recognized with opportunities for increased responsibilities, higher pay, and wage reviews as often as every six months.



This Probably Isn't the Right Fit If...

Please don't apply if you:

- Frequently struggle with organization or deadlines

- Have unreliable internet service

- Are not comfortable communicating in English

- Are looking for a short-term job with little opportunity for growth

- Don't enjoy detailed, repetitive work



How to Apply

If this sounds like a position you'd genuinely enjoy, I'd love to hear from you!

Please include:

Your
 address

Whether you have Lightroom Classic (don't worry if you don't!)

Confirmation that you have a reliable, high-speed internet connection

A little about yourself

What your biggest dream or aspiration is

I look forward to meeting you!

— Cescily

description:
Title: AI Platform & Product Operations Lead

Hours: 50 Hours/mo

Rate of Pay: $800 - $950 a month (Rate of Pay $16-$19/hour USD)



This role will begin by auditing and strengthening the business’s internal technical ecosystem, with a focus on creating a robust customer funnel tracking system from awareness to sales. Once that foundation is in place, the role will expand into building a client-facing platform that allows our clients to track their own business inputs and outputs, supported by dashboards, AI tools, trainings, and strategic resources



Self Made is a premier global business consultancy and transformation platform dedicated to building a new generation of successful female entrepreneurs. We provide established female founders and service-based business owners with a strategic roadmap combined with modern marketing strategy, tool integration, and community resources to create true leverage, profitability, and operational freedom. Our comprehensive approach explicitly addresses both technical growth requirements and the deeper professional confidence challenges that arise during business scaling. Guided by an absolute commitment to excellence in execution, we exist to help brilliant women combine their lifelong expertise with contemporary rules of visibility to achieve wealth and impact on their own terms



Accountability: Phase 1

*Technical ecosystem audit

- Review the full business tech stack across CRM,
, payments, forms, automations, analytics, content platforms, and Airtable

- Map how leads currently move from awareness to enquiry to sale

- Identify data gaps, broken handoffs, duplicate tools, and manual workarounds

- Assess which systems are reliable enough to keep and which need replacing or restructuring

- Document the current-state architecture in a way that is clear and usable



*Funnel tracking and measurement

- Build a robust way to track the customer journey from awareness through to conversion

- Define the key funnel stages and what each one means in your business

- Establish the core metrics to measure at each stage

- Create logic for tracking lead source, conversion points, sales activity, and customer movement

- Make sure the data can be viewed consistently and updated accurately



*Systems integration and data structure

- Connect the key systems needed to support clean funnel visibility

- Improve how Airtable is used as a source of truth where relevant

- Consolidate fragmented data from Stripe, School, and Kit into a single Airtable relational database, establishing a unified

Source of Truth with zero duplicate records within the first 30 days.

- Ensure data flows correctly between tools and is structured for long-term use

- Reduce fragmentation across platforms

- Create a setup that can later support a client-facing dashboard



*Operational visibility and reporting

- Build internal reporting views that allow you to clearly see business performance

- Create dashboards or views for sales pipeline, leads, content performance, and conversion trends

- Make reporting practical and decision-focused, not just data-heavy

- Ensure reporting supports fast insight into what is and is not working



*Documentation and implementation standards

- Document the systems, workflows, tracking logic, and definitions

- Create SOPs for ongoing maintenance and team use

- Establish standards for naming, permissions, and data hygiene

- Build the setup so it can be maintained and expanded over time



Phase 2:

*Client platform design

- Translate the internal system into a client-facing experience

- Design how clients will track both input and output in their business

- Structure a performance dashboard so it is simple, strategic, and useful

- Ensure the platform helps clients understand performance and take action



*Client business tracking framework

- Build a model clients can use to track their own awareness, leads, sales activity, and growth

- Define which inputs they should monitor, such as content, outreach, offers, and sales actions

- Define which outputs they should monitor, such as leads, inbound requests, calls booked, deals closed, and revenue

- Make sure the framework is easy to use and relevant for coaching clients



*AI and strategic tools integration

- Integrate useful AI-supported tools into the client experience

- Build access to competitor research workflows

- Include transcription and summary features for content and learning

- Create access to custom GPTs or guided AI tools for idea development and execution support

- Ensure AI tools are practical, safe, and well-structured for client use



*Training and guided implementation

- Link the dashboard experience to trainings, resources, and strategic guidance

- Build a systemised checklist approach to business building inside the platform

- Make sure clients know what to do next based on their current business data

- Connect education to execution so the platform drives action, not just insight



*Events and client engagement

- Build a calendar view for upcoming events, trainings, and key touchpoints

- Make the platform feel like an active business-growth environment rather than a static portal

- Support client engagement through visibility, reminders, and structured planning



*Scale, quality, and long-term platform ownership

- Ensure the platform is built for long-term use, not quick fixes

- Create a permissions structure that protects client data appropriately

- Maintain data quality, usability, and reliability as the platform grows

- Identify future improvements and help shape the long-term product roadmap

- Design and execute a production-ready client interface through reliable API/Zapier schemas engineered to support 100–500 active concurrent users without system lag or handoff breakage.



Tasks:

*Review and optimise our systems daily to ensure the customer journey from awareness to sale is clear, effective, and scalable.

*Track and report on key business metrics, turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

*Build and maintain the operational infrastructure of the business, including Airtable, automations, integrations, and SOPs.

*Approach problems with clear structure and strategic thinking, turning ideas and gaps into practical solutions

*Communicate progress through daily updates, keeping the founder informed on wins, issues, priorities, and next actions.



Expectations:

*3+ years in operations, systems, product operations, business intelligence, or digital product implementation

*Experience setting up or improving reporting dashboards and data flows

*Experience building or managing automations and integrations

*Experience building robust, scalable digital platforms for long-term use, with a clear understanding of clean system architecture, reliability, and user experience at scale. Must be able to create proper production-ready systems rather than quick, patchwork, or vibe-coded solutions, with the ability to support at least 100 active users.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea
mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Instagram DM Setter for Beauty Education Brand
description:
We are looking for a confident, proactive and sales-driven DM Setter to join our growing beauty education brand.



This role is not just replying to messages. You will be responsible for starting genuine conversations, nurturing warm leads, following up enquiries and helping turn interested followers into paid students for our online and in-person brow training programs.



You must be comfortable working toward sales targets, building relationships through Instagram DMs and taking initiative without needing to be constantly reminded.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Responding to Instagram DMs, story replies and course enquiries

* Following up warm leads who have asked about training, clicked links or shown interest

* Starting genuine conversations with relevant followers and potential students

* Conducting daily DM outreach and networking

* Reacting and replying to followers’ stories to build visibility and connection

* Engaging with relevant beauty accounts and potential students

* Nurturing leads without sounding pushy or overly sales-focused

* Understanding each lead’s goals and recommending the most suitable training option

* Sending course information, payment links, discount codes and enrolment details

* Following up leads consistently until they enrol or clearly decline

* Re-engaging older leads and previous enquiries

* Keeping accurate notes of conversations, follow-ups and sales

* Working through our existing ManyChat leads and Instagram enquiries

* Reporting daily on conversations, leads, follow-ups and sales

* Sending an end-of-day message listing all tasks completed before clocking off



What we are looking for:



* Previous experience in DM setting, appointment setting, sales or lead generation

* Strong written English and confident communication skills

* Experience using Instagram for business

* Comfortable initiating conversations and following up multiple times

* Naturally warm, personable and relationship-focused

* Sales-driven and motivated by commission

* Highly organised and able to manage a large number of conversations

* Reliable, accountable and consistent

* Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural and human

* Confident using tracking software such as Hubstaff

* Available to work during agreed Australian business hours



Beauty, brow or online education experience is highly desirable, but not essential if you have strong sales experience and are willing to learn the brand.



This role is suitable for someone who:



* Loves speaking with people

* Is confident starting conversations

* Understands how to build trust before selling

* Does not give up after one follow-up

* Can identify warm leads and buying signals

* Wants to grow with the business long-term

* Takes ownership of their results



Pay structure:



* Weekly base rate

* Commission on every successful sale

* Additional earning potential based on performance



Final pay will depend on experience, availability and proven results.



How to apply:



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous DM setting, sales or appointment-setting experience

3. Screenshots or proof of sales, booked calls, conversions or results you have achieved

4. An example of how you would respond to a lead who says:

    “I really want to do the course, but I’m not sure if I’m ready yet.”

5. Your availability and preferred working hours

6. Your expected weekly base rate and commission structure



Applications without proof of previous results or a personalised response will not be considered.

title: AI Music Creator — Paid Per Accepted Song
description:
Renew Daily is looking for six creative music makers from the Philippines who have a strong ear for memorable hooks, melodies, and emotional songs.



This is not an hourly position. You will be paid for each song that Renew Daily chooses to purchase.



What I am looking for



I am primarily listening for:



A strong, memorable chorus

A hook people remember after one listen

An emotional melody

Good musical structure

Music that makes someone stop and listen



The current lyrics are not very important. I will rewrite the lyrics later.



Your song may be in English, Filipino, or another language. The language does not matter if the melody and hook are strong.



Music styles



I am looking for songs in three main styles:



* Country

* Rock

, Pop Rock, Anthemic Pop Rock, Alternative Pop, Indie Pop, Folk Pop, Acoustic Pop, Adult Contemporary, Cinematic Pop, and Electropop.



You may specialize in one style or create in all three.



You do not need to buy anything



You do not need a paid Suno membership to apply.



Please do not spend money to apply for this position.



You may submit:



An original song you already created

A song created with Suno

A song you wrote or produced yourself

A song in any language



After I select the six creators, I will purchase a paid Suno membership for each selected creator.



Payment

$10 USD for every song I accept and purchase

You may submit as many songs as you want after being selected

There are no required working hours

There is no guaranteed number of purchased songs

Songs I do not purchase remain yours

Songs I purchase become exclusive to Renew Daily

Payment will be made regularly for accepted songs



A productive creator with strong musical instincts may have several songs purchased.



Important



Only submit original music that you created and have the right to sell.



Do not submit:



Famous cover songs

Copied melodies

Music owned by another person

Songs already sold exclusively to someone else

Unauthorized samples or recordings

How to apply



Begin your application with:



I HEAR THE HOOK



Then send me:



A short introduction

One to three of your strongest original songs

The exact timestamp where the strongest hook or chorus begins

The style of each song

Whether you currently use Suno

Which genre you create best

Confirmation that you understand payment is $10 per accepted song

Confirmation that purchased songs will belong exclusively to Renew Daily



Do not send ten average songs. Send your best one to three songs.



I do not care whether the production is perfect. I want to hear whether you can create a melody and hook that people will remember. Reply to me in a message with a link to the songs

title: Mobile Game Ad Producer
description:
We are a US-based mobile gaming creative agency producing ad content for multiple mobile game clients. We are looking for a skilled part-time producer to join our team on an ongoing monthly basis. This is not a one-time project. If things go well, this becomes a long-term working relationship.

What you will be doing

We provide everything you need to execute: scripts, shot lists, creative briefs, all character and background assets, gameplay footage, and brand guidelines. Your job is to take that material and produce finished ad creative across video and static formats.

On the video side, that means assembling footage in CapCut, applying motion effects, syncing voiceover, cutting to pacing notes, and delivering clean final exports across multiple aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:5). On the static side, that means building polished ad images in Canva using provided assets and layout direction.

You will also be working with AI video and image generation tools as part of the production process. We use Higgsfield (which includes Kling, Seedance, and Wan), ElevenLabs for voiceover, and GPT Image generation for character and scene work. You do not need to know every tool on day one, but you need to be comfortable learning new tools quickly and using AI outputs as production assets rather than finished work.

What a typical month looks like

Roughly one day of work per week. Each month includes a mix of video ads (with different hook variations), static ads across multiple formats, and occasional store asset updates. We deliver a brief, you execute, you submit drafts for review, and we go into a revision round before final delivery.

What we are looking for

Solid CapCut skills, including compositing, transitions, text animation, and multi-format export. Canva proficiency for static ad production. Experience with AI video or image tools, or a clear willingness to learn. Strong attention to file organization, naming conventions, and export specs. Ability to follow a creative brief precisely and flag questions before going too far in the wrong direction. Good English communication, since briefs and feedback are all in English.

A portfolio of video ad work or social media content is required to be considered. Please show us work that demonstrates you can assemble footage, add motion, and deliver a polished final product.

Compensation

$500 USD per month, paid twice monthly via Wise or PayPal. Rate is open to discussion based on experience and portfolio quality.

To apply

Send your portfolio or work samples, a note about your experience with AI creative tools specifically, and two to three sentences about the most relevant work you have done. Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

3+ years as a hands-on Shopify store manager working inside Shopify admin daily — not a developer, not a strategist

Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously

title: Part-Time Project Engineer – Cost Tracking & Project Scheduling

Company: Sydney-Based Construction Company

Work Type: Part-Time (20 hours/week) | Long-Term Role

Work Hours: Flexible, with some availability required during Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT), Monday–Friday

________________________________________

About Us

Re Con Building Group is a Sydney-based construction company specialising in high-quality residential renovations, extensions, new homes and duplex developments.

We are looking for a dependable, organised and detail-focused Project Engineer to assist with project cost tracking, back costing, construction scheduling and maintaining accurate project information within our construction management software.

You will work directly with the company director, who is a licensed builder and former structural engineer, to improve the financial tracking, scheduling and administration of our construction projects.

This is a long-term position for someone who understands construction projects and wants to become an important part of a growing Australian building company.

________________________________________

You are highly organised, comfortable working with numbers and able to understand how construction projects are planned, costed and delivered.

You take ownership of your responsibilities, follow up on missing information and make sure project records remain accurate and up to date.

The ideal candidate has previously worked with a construction company and has experience with tasks such as:

• Project cost tracking

• Back costing and budget reviews

• Construction take-offs

• Transaction allocation

• Project scheduling

• Supplier and subcontractor cost management

Experience working with an Australian construction company is a major advantage.

Double bonus if you have previously worked with a Sydney-based builder or construction company.

???? Project Cost Tracking & Back Costing

• Experience using construction management or job-costing software

title: PPC Account Manager - Must Have 5 Years of Experience + Agency Experience
description:
**Do not apply if you do not have at least 5 years of experience as a PPC Account Manager. Agency experience preferred. 



We are looking for a detail-oriented PPC Account Manager to support the day-to-day management, optimization, and performance of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and related platforms.



This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple client accounts, and experienced in the ongoing maintenance required to keep PPC campaigns efficient, accurate, and performance-focused. The right candidate should be proactive, analytical, and able to identify opportunities for improvement across keywords, search terms, ad copy, placements, landing pages, tracking, and overall account structure.



Responsibilities



Account Optimization & Maintenance



* Regularly audit search terms across client accounts to identify negative keywords, new keyword opportunities, and performance trends

* Maintain MCC-level negative keyword lists, shared negative lists, and account-level negatives

* Review Display, YouTube, Demand Gen, and Performance Max placements to identify and exclude irrelevant or low-quality traffic

* Review Google Ads recommendations weekly, applying or dismissing recommendations with clear rationale

* Monitor bid strategies and make adjustments based on performance, goals, and account needs

* Manage brand safety settings, content suitability exclusions, and placement controls

* Set up, review, and monitor location extensions and other relevant ad assets

* Support general day-to-day account hygiene across multiple PPC accounts



Documentation & Process Management



* Log all PPC account changes clearly and consistently in client history/change documentation

* Record bid strategy changes, budget changes, targeting updates, exclusions, ad tests, and other optimizations

* Use task management tools to track work, deadlines, time, and account updates

* Communicate account changes and recommendations clearly to internal team members



Ad Copy & Testing



* Write and refresh Google Ads copy, including responsive search ad headlines and descriptions

* Support A/B testing of ad messaging, offers, CTAs, and landing page alignment

* Identify underperforming ads and recommend copy updates based on performance data

* Use AI tools responsibly to assist with ad copy ideation, research, and testing variations



Tracking, Lead Quality & Reporting Support



* Monitor conversion tracking and lead tracking platforms to help ensure lead data is accurate

* Review lead quality trends and help identify whether performance issues are related to traffic quality, conversion tracking, landing pages, or client-side intake

* Monitor WhatConverts or similar lead tracking platforms, including alerts, lead intelligence, and call/form data

* Assist with diagnosing conversion tracking issues in GA4, GTM, Google Ads, and related platforms

* Support enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and other tracking improvements when needed



Research & Strategy Support



* Review auction insights, competitor ad copy, competitor landing pages, and search results to identify opportunities

* Make landing page improvement recommendations based on UX, conversion rate optimization, message match, and lead quality

* Stay current on Google Ads updates, PPC trends, new betas, AI tools, and platform changes

* Bring proactive recommendations to improve account performance, efficiency, and scalability



Platforms & Tools



The ideal candidate should have experience with, or be comfortable learning:



* Google Ads: Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Demand Gen

* Microsoft Ads

* Google Local Services Ads

* Google Merchant Center

* GA4 and Google Tag Manager

* WhatConverts or similar lead tracking platforms

* ClickCease or similar click fraud management tools

* Looker Studio

* Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar landing page behavior tools

* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or similar AI tools

* ClickUp or similar task management and time tracking platforms

* WordPress experience is a plus, especially for basic landing page edits



Qualifications



* Hands-on experience managing PPC accounts, preferably across multiple clients or industries

* Strong understanding of Google Ads account structure, search terms, negative keywords, match types, bidding strategies, and conversion tracking

* Experience managing or supporting multiple accounts with different budgets, goals, and industries

* Ability to analyze performance data and identify the difference between tracking issues, traffic quality issues, landing page issues, and client intake issues

* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow internal processes

* Comfortable documenting changes and explaining the reasoning behind optimizations

* Strong written communication skills

* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and stay organized across multiple accounts

* Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate recommendations is a plus

* Experience with enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and advanced tracking setups is a plus



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is not only comfortable inside Google Ads, but also understands the importance of consistent account maintenance. This person should enjoy digging into search terms, spotting wasted spend, finding opportunities, improving ad copy, reviewing tracking data, and keeping accounts organized.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and able to balance daily account hygiene with bigger-picture performance improvements.
